bug.title: A child nonzero exit can be lost after a pass marker
bug.summary: The historical run_all path emitted release-ready green after a fake child printed pass and exited 7; the required real child return-code contract was absent from the supplied gate.

steps: Run the historical aggregate with a child that prints a pass marker and exits 7.
Observe the aggregate result and real process exit code separately.
reproduction.observed: The trusted source gate independently binds the raw command exit, adapter exit, observation, TestResultV1, and aggregate; a pass marker followed by nonzero status cannot seal green.

confirmed_facts.statement: The supplied v0.8.3 audit records a pass marker followed by child exit 7 in the historical aggregate.
The trusted source gate independently binds the raw command exit, adapter exit, observation, TestResultV1, and aggregate; a pass marker followed by nonzero status cannot seal green.
